name: Draugr
description: A corporeal revenant of Old Norse and Icelandic tradition, the draugr is an animated corpse with superhuman strength, magical abilities, and a violent jealousy toward the living, most often encountered as a guardian of treasure in a burial mound or as a re-walking neighbour terrorizing a farmstead.

aliases.name: Haugbúi
aliases.meaning: Mound-dweller — draugr who remains in the burial mound

origin: Old Norse and post-Norse Scandinavia: Iceland, Norway, the Faroe Islands, with related traditions in Sweden, Denmark, and the Northern Isles of Britain (Orkney, Shetland).
